obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the provider's own close links to other undertakings, singly and in a yearly return
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärkteanzeigenverordnung (KMAnzV), BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 153, § 4

titles.en: Notify the provider's own close links to other undertakings, singly and in a yearly return

summaries.en: A crypto-asset service provider notifies its close links to other undertakings on the form in Annex 3, and again when a change reaches, exceeds or falls below 30 or 50 per cent, the undertaking becomes or stops being its subsidiary, or the shares move or the chain of intermediate holders changes. It files a collective return of numbered partial notices as at 31 December by 15 June of the following year, or only an informal confirmation where nothing has changed since the last one, and gives book values and prices when asked.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify material outsourcing and material changes to it through BaFin's platform with the listed data
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärkteanzeigenverordnung (KMAnzV), BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 153, § 5 Abs. 1 bis 3

titles.en: Notify material outsourcing and material changes to it through BaFin's platform with the listed data

summaries.en: A notice of an intended or completed material outsourcing gives the nineteen items the section lists, from a reference number, term and notice periods, activities and data, provider, group links and locations to the cloud model, materiality and risk assessments, approval, governing law, audits, sub-outsourcing, replaceability and annual budget, and the contract is handed over on request. Material changes, such as important contract changes, a changed materiality or replaceability assessment, new sub-outsourcing, a move to a third country, termination or a change of control over the provider, are notified too, all electronically through BaFin's reporting and publication platform.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify serious incidents in an existing material outsourcing
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärkteanzeigenverordnung (KMAnzV), BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 153, § 5 Abs. 4

titles.en: Notify serious incidents in an existing material outsourcing

summaries.en: A crypto-asset service provider notifies serious incidents in an existing material outsourcing that may materially affect its business, such as a lasting interruption of the service, serious breaches of contract or law by the provider, significant security incidents, weak risk and contingency management or resources at the provider, doubts about the reliability of its managers, its threatened insolvency, serious damage to its reputation or conflicts at its seat in a third country.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report managers' side activities and holdings on the set forms
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärkteanzeigenverordnung (KMAnzV), BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 153, § 7

titles.en: Report managers' side activities and holdings on the set forms

summaries.en: Notices of a managing director's side activities give the undertaking, the start and end, the nature and the time taken, on the form in Annex 4. Notices of holdings of managing directors and those responsible for management give the acquisition, change or disposal, the undertaking and the percentage held, on the form in Annex 5.

instruments.title: Add KMMV, the German regulation on notifying BaFin of disclosed inside information under § 36 of the Crypto Markets Supervision Act (Kryptomärktemitteilungs-Verordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärktemitteilungs-Verordnung (KMMV), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 197, made by the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht under § 1g Nr. 2 of the regulation transferring powers to BaFin of 13 December 2002, as amended in 2025 (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and no Stand line (text as enacted); entry into force not read, the regulation naming only the day after its promulgation

titles.de: Verordnung zur Konkretisierung von Mitteilungspflichten zur Offenlegung von Insiderinformationen nach § 36 des Kryptomärkteaufsichtsgesetzes (Kryptomärktemitteilungs-Verordnung - KMMV)
titles.en: Crypto Markets Inside Information Notification Regulation

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell BaFin electronically the text, time and media of each inside information publication and a contact person
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärktemitteilungs-Verordnung (KMMV), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 197, § 2 und § 3

titles.en: Tell BaFin electronically the text, time and media of each inside information publication and a contact person

summaries.en: An issuer, offeror or person seeking admission to trading of crypto-assets that must send BaFin the inside information it has published under Article 88(1) of the MiCA Regulation states the wording, the time and the specific media channels of the publication, and a contact person with telephone number and e-mail address. It sends this electronically on the channel BaFin announces on its website, which may be BaFin's reporting and publication system.

obligations.title: Add the duty: List every review of the reasons and everyone involved in a notice of delayed disclosure
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärktemitteilungs-Verordnung (KMMV), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 197, § 4

titles.en: List every review of the reasons and everyone involved in a notice of delayed disclosure

summaries.en: A notice to BaFin that disclosure of inside information was delayed under Article 88(3) of the MiCA Regulation gives, beyond what Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2861 requires, every date on which the continued grounds for delay were reviewed, and the names, business addresses, business telephone numbers and e-mail addresses of everyone involved in the decision to delay. It is sent on the same electronic channel.

instruments.title: Add TrDüV, the German regulation on transmitting data to the transparency register (Transparenzregisterdatenübermittlungsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Transparenzregisterdatenübermittlungsverordnung (TrDüV), BGBl. I S. 2090, made by the Bundesministerium der Finanzen under § 22 Abs. 4 GwG (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Geändert durch Art. 10 G v. 25.6.2021 I 2083); entry into force not read, the regulation naming only the day after its promulgation

titles.de: Verordnung zur Datenübermittlung durch Mitteilungsverpflichtete und durch den Betreiber des Unternehmensregisters an das Transparenzregister (Transparenzregisterdatenübermittlungsverordnung - TrDüV)
titles.en: Transparency Register Data Transmission Regulation

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register an account with the transparency register and file the minimum details
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Transparenzregisterdatenübermittlungsverordnung (TrDüV), BGBl. I S. 2090, § 1

titles.en: Register an account with the transparency register and file the minimum details

summaries.en: A legal entity or arrangement that must report its beneficial owners registers on the transparency register's website with a valid e-mail address and a password, itself or through someone acting for it, and activates the account. It then files the minimum details the section lists, its name, the person responsible for the registration with address, e-mail and telephone, on the register's forms and over the secured connection the register sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Update the transparency register registration details without delay when they change
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Transparenzregisterdatenübermittlungsverordnung (TrDüV), BGBl. I S. 2090, § 2

titles.en: Update the transparency register registration details without delay when they change

summaries.en: When any of the minimum registration details change, the registered entity must change them in the transparency register without delay, itself or through someone it engages.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File beneficial owner details on the register's forms over its secure connection
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Transparenzregisterdatenübermittlungsverordnung (TrDüV), BGBl. I S. 2090, § 3

titles.en: File beneficial owner details on the register's forms over its secure connection

summaries.en: The details of the entity's beneficial owners that the Anti-Money Laundering Act requires are filed on the transparency register's website, on the forms the register provides and over the secured internet connection it specifies. The register confirms receipt in the user account.

instruments.title: Add EdWBeitrV, the German regulation on contributions to the investor compensation scheme of securities trading firms at the KfW (EdW-Beitragsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, EdW-Beitragsverordnung (EdWBeitrV), BGBl. I S. 1891, made by the Bundesministerium der Finanzen under § 8 Abs. 3 Satz 1 und 2 of the Einlagensicherungs- und Anlegerentschädigungsgesetz of 16 July 1998 (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 10 G v. 9.4.2026 I Nr. 97); entry into force not read, the regulation naming only the day after its promulgation

titles.de: Verordnung über die Beiträge zu der Entschädigungseinrichtung der Wertpapierhandelsunternehmen bei der Kreditanstalt für Wiederaufbau (EdW-Beitragsverordnung - EdWBeitrV)
titles.en: Regulation on Contributions to the Compensation Scheme of Securities Trading Firms

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the annual contribution to the EdW by 30 September, at least the set minimum
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, EdW-Beitragsverordnung (EdWBeitrV), BGBl. I S. 1891, § 1 Abs. 1 und 1a

titles.en: Pay the annual contribution to the EdW by 30 September, at least the set minimum

summaries.en: An institution assigned to the compensation scheme of securities trading firms on 1 January pays an annual contribution by 30 September, calculated from its contribution-relevant income and capped at 10 per cent of its annual surplus, but at least 1,050 euros, or 2,100 euros if it may hold clients' money or securities. It reports to the scheme, with its adopted annual accounts, the amounts of any provisions for contribution duties formed, released or used and of any notional manager's salary deducted.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File auditor-confirmed contribution figures with the EdW by 1 July
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, EdW-Beitragsverordnung (EdWBeitrV), BGBl. I S. 1891, § 2 Abs. 3 bis 5

titles.en: File auditor-confirmed contribution figures with the EdW by 1 July

summaries.en: The institution files the figures needed to calculate its annual contribution, with an auditor's confirmation that they are materially and arithmetically correct, by 1 July of each settlement year, based on its adopted and audited accounts for the last financial year ending before 1 March. Figures filed late but before 15 August cost a 10 per cent surcharge; after that the scheme estimates the income and sets 1.35 times the contribution as a payment on account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay a one-off amount equal to the annual contribution when newly assigned to the EdW
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, EdW-Beitragsverordnung (EdWBeitrV), BGBl. I S. 1891, § 3

titles.en: Pay a one-off amount equal to the annual contribution when newly assigned to the EdW

summaries.en: An institution newly assigned to the scheme after 18 July 2013 pays, together with its first annual contribution, a one-off amount equal to that contribution, or the minimum contribution if it owes no annual contribution, and pays the minimum contribution first on assignment, which is credited against it.

instruments.title: Add RStruktFV, the German regulation on raising contributions to the restructuring fund for credit institutions (Restrukturierungsfonds-Verordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Restrukturierungsfonds-Verordnung (RStruktFV), BGBl. I S. 1268, made by the Bundesregierung under § 12g of the Restrukturierungsfondsgesetz (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Geändert durch Art. 9 G v. 23.12.2016 I 3171); entry into force not read, the regulation naming only the day after its promulgation

titles.de: Verordnung über die Erhebung der Beiträge zum Restrukturierungsfonds für Kreditinstitute (Restrukturierungsfonds-Verordnung - RStruktFV)
titles.en: Restructuring Fund Contributions Regulation

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the resolution authority the extra data for the restructuring fund risk indicators
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Restrukturierungsfonds-Verordnung (RStruktFV), BGBl. I S. 1268, § 6 Abs. 1 und 8

titles.en: Send the resolution authority the extra data for the restructuring fund risk indicators

summaries.en: A CRR credit institution or investment firm liable to contribute to the restructuring fund, other than the investment firms § 1 Abs. 1 names, sends the resolution authority, beside the data the EU contributions regulation already requires, the data it needs for the additional risk indicators, for the year of the relevant annual accounts. These include the trading book items and the off-balance-sheet items of form 1 of the bank accounting regulation, the notional volume of forward transactions, the share of derivatives cleared through a central counterparty, its institutional protection scheme, and the end date of any restructuring plan or term of any liquidation plan after public support, all within the deadlines of Articles 14 and 20 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/63.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report total liabilities, covered deposits and own funds as a lump-sum contributor
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Restrukturierungsfonds-Verordnung (RStruktFV), BGBl. I S. 1268, § 6 Abs. 2 und 8 und § 1 Abs. 3

titles.en: Report total liabilities, covered deposits and own funds as a lump-sum contributor

summaries.en: The investment firms § 1 Abs. 1 describes by reference to Article 96(1) of the CRR and Annex I of Directive 2004/39/EC, and German branches of EU institutions, which pay a contribution set by bands of their liabilities, send the resolution authority at single entity level their total liabilities, their covered deposits and their own funds as the regulation defines them, for the year of the relevant annual accounts and within the EU deadlines.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Confirm that contribution data are correct and have them confirmed by the auditor on request
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Restrukturierungsfonds-Verordnung (RStruktFV), BGBl. I S. 1268, § 6 Abs. 4 bis 6

titles.en: Confirm that contribution data are correct and have them confirmed by the auditor on request

summaries.en: Every institution liable to contribute confirms to the resolution authority that the information it sends under the EU contributions regulation and this regulation is materially and arithmetically correct. Where the resolution authority asks, an institution outside the small institution rules has the correctness confirmed by its auditor, or by its auditing association for a cooperative or by the savings banks association's audit office for a savings bank, and it answers requests for further evidence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give planned balance sheet figures where no annual accounts exist yet for the reference year
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Restrukturierungsfonds-Verordnung (RStruktFV), BGBl. I S. 1268, § 6 Abs. 7

titles.en: Give planned balance sheet figures where no annual accounts exist yet for the reference year

summaries.en: An institution that cannot present annual accounts for the reference year because it was not yet active has its contribution calculated on planned balance sheets, provides one for each contribution period when the resolution authority asks, and estimates and sends any positions and indicators the planned balance sheet does not show.

instruments.title: Add RechZahlV, the German regulation on the accounts of payment institutions and e-money institutions (Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung (RechZahlV), BGBl. I S. 3680, made by the Bundesministerium der Justiz under § 330 Abs. 2 HGB (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 25 Abs. 3 G v. 7.8.2021 I 3311); entry into force read in § 34

titles.de: Verordnung über die Rechnungslegung der Zahlungsinstitute und E-Geld-Institute (Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung - RechZahlV)
titles.en: Accounting Regulation for Payment Institutions and E-money Institutions

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up the balance sheet and income statement on the forms for payment institutions
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung (RechZahlV), BGBl. I S. 3680, § 2 und § 31

titles.en: Draw up the balance sheet and income statement on the forms for payment institutions

summaries.en: A payment or e-money institution draws up its balance sheet on form 1 and its income statement in vertical format on form 2 in the annexes, instead of the layouts of §§ 266 and 275 of the Commercial Code. The regulation's rules apply to its consolidated accounts too, unless their nature calls for a difference.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show payment services, e-money issuance and other business separately in the accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung (RechZahlV), BGBl. I S. 3680, § 3

titles.en: Show payment services, e-money issuance and other business separately in the accounts

summaries.en: The institution shows the figures for payment services, for issuing e-money and for its other business separately, dividing the balance sheet and income statement items by where they come from as the forms set out. It shows receivables from and liabilities to affiliated undertakings and undertakings in which it holds a participation as separate sub-items of the items listed, or in the notes in the order of those items.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show subordinated items separately and break customer receivables and liabilities down by residual maturity
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung (RechZahlV), BGBl. I S. 3680, § 4 und § 7

titles.en: Show subordinated items separately and break customer receivables and liabilities down by residual maturity

summaries.en: Assets and liabilities that rank behind other creditors in liquidation or insolvency are shown as subordinated, subordinated assets separately under their item or in the notes. In the notes the institution breaks its receivables from and liabilities to customers down by residual maturity into up to three months, three to six months, six to twelve months and over twelve months.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Break income down by geographic market and state loans to managers and board members in the notes
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung (RechZahlV), BGBl. I S. 3680, § 28 Abs. 2

titles.en: Break income down by geographic market and state loans to managers and board members in the notes

summaries.en: In place of certain Commercial Code disclosures, the notes break interest income, current income from shares and holdings, commission income and other operating income down by geographic markets that differ materially for the institution, unless that would cause it or a 20 per cent holding serious harm. They also state, for each group of persons, the total advances and loans granted to members of the management body, supervisory board, advisory board or similar body and the guarantees given for them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Add the required item disclosures and the number and volume of payments executed to the notes
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung (RechZahlV), BGBl. I S. 3680, § 29

titles.en: Add the required item disclosures and the number and volume of payments executed to the notes

summaries.en: The notes break down marketable securities into listed and unlisted, state securities not valued at the lower of cost or market and how they are distinguished, explain material amounts in the other assets, liabilities, income and expense items, and give significant administration and agency services for third parties, foreign currency assets and liabilities in euros, land and equipment, and the terms of large subordinated borrowings. They also state the number of payment transactions the institution executed and their volume in euros.

obligations.title: Add the duty: List open forward transactions by type in the notes and say whether they hedge or trade
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsinstituts-Rechnungslegungsverordnung (RechZahlV), BGBl. I S. 3680, § 30

titles.en: List open forward transactions by type in the notes and say whether they hedge or trade

summaries.en: The notes list the types of foreign currency, interest rate and other price-related forward transactions not yet settled at the balance sheet date, in those three groups, and state for each group whether a material part serves to hedge interest, exchange rate or market price movements and whether a material part is trading business.

instruments.title: Add VersVermV, the German regulation on insurance intermediation and advice (Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung), as far as it binds a credit institution distributing insurance
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung (VersVermV), BGBl. I S. 2483; 2019 I S. 411, made by the Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie (footnote to the title); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Geändert durch Art. 1 V v. 17.2.2025 I Nr. 43); entry into force read in the footnote to the title

titles.de: Verordnung über die Versicherungsvermittlung und -beratung (Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung - VersVermV)
titles.en: Insurance Distribution Regulation

payload.officialRef: Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung vom 17. Dezember 2018 (BGBl. I S. 2483; 2019 I S. 411)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep five years of records of the insurance distribution training of the firm and its staff
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung (VersVermV), BGBl. I S. 2483; 2019 I S. 411, § 7

titles.en: Keep five years of records of the insurance distribution training of the firm and its staff

summaries.en: A distributor bound to continuing training under § 34d Abs. 9 of the Trade Regulation Code makes sure the training matches the activities carried on and collects evidence of the training it and its staff involved in distribution took, showing each person, the date, scope, content and title of the measure and the provider. It keeps the records for five years from the end of the training year on a durable medium at its business premises and gives the chamber of commerce, when ordered, a declaration on the form in Annex 4 that the training duty was met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the intermediary register data and any change to them without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung (VersVermV), BGBl. I S. 2483; 2019 I S. 411, § 9

titles.en: Report the intermediary register data and any change to them without delay

summaries.en: A distributor that must be entered in the intermediary register reports the data to be entered to the register authority and any change to them without delay. A tied agent that needs no licence under § 34d Abs. 7 of the Trade Regulation Code has its data reported only through the insurer under § 48 Abs. 4 of the Insurance Supervision Act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold the product and target market information and do not pay staff in ways that steer sales
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung (VersVermV), BGBl. I S. 2483; 2019 I S. 411, § 14

titles.en: Hold the product and target market information and do not pay staff in ways that steer sales

summaries.en: The distributor must hold all relevant information on each insurance product and its approval process, including its target market, except for large risks. It must not pay or assess its staff in a way that conflicts with their duty to act in the policyholder's best interest, nor set incentives through pay, sales targets or otherwise to recommend one product where another would meet the customer's needs better.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the policyholder at first contact who the firm is, its register status and how it is paid
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung (VersVermV), BGBl. I S. 2483; 2019 I S. 411, § 15 und § 16

titles.en: Tell the policyholder at first contact who the firm is, its register status and how it is paid

summaries.en: At the first business contact the distributor gives the policyholder, on paper or under set conditions another durable medium or a website, clearly, free of charge and in an agreed or official language, its name and address, the capacity in which it is registered and how to check the entry, whether it advises, the nature and source of its pay and any other benefits, holdings above 10 per cent with insurers in either direction, and the address of the dispute resolution body. After a telephone contact the information follows at once, and the distributor makes sure its staff give the same information, except for reinsurance and large risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set and apply insurance complaint guidelines, keep a complaints register and answer promptly
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung (VersVermV), BGBl. I S. 2483; 2019 I S. 411, § 17

titles.en: Set and apply insurance complaint guidelines, keep a complaints register and answer promptly

summaries.en: A distributor licensed under § 34d Abs. 1 or 2 of the Trade Regulation Code sets guidelines for handling complaints, applies and monitors them and makes them available in writing to the staff concerned. It sets up a complaints function where its size calls for it, registers every complaint and lets the chamber of commerce inspect the register, acknowledges and examines each complaint and answers without delay in plain language or explains the delay, publishes how to complain, gives reasons where it cannot meet a complaint, and takes part in the insurance dispute resolution procedure when the policyholder calls on it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Avoid conflicts and keep inducements from harming the quality of insurance investment product sales
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvermittlungsverordnung (VersVermV), BGBl. I S. 2483; 2019 I S. 411, § 18 und § 19

titles.en: Avoid conflicts and keep inducements from harming the quality of insurance investment product sales

summaries.en: A distributor of insurance-based investment products takes appropriate steps to identify and avoid conflicts of interest between itself, its staff and connected persons and its policyholders, applying § 48a Abs. 4 and 5 of the Insurance Supervision Act accordingly. It makes sure that any inducement it pays or receives from a third party in connection with such a sale does not harm the quality of the service or its duty to act honestly, fairly and professionally in the policyholder's best interest.
